BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on College & Workforce Development.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Allowing regional universities to offer doctorate level degrees in education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing regional universities to offer doctorate level degrees in education; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.35 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 28B.35 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The boards of trustees of the regional universities may offer applied, but not research, doctorate level degrees in education.
